def _create_sample_tree(tmp_path):
    """
    Create a minimal Doorstop tree with a single document and a single item.
    The tree is created in the temporary directory and returned.
    """
    from doorstop import Tree, Document, Item

    tree = Tree(tmp_path)
    doc = tree.create_document()
    doc.add_item(level=1, heading="Sample Requirement", text="This is a test.")
